name: workspace-tracker-product-split-registry
purpose: Defines the split between the desktop workspace tracker product and the separate agent/tool operations desktop app.

reader_guide.summary: Use this registry before changing desktop home, navigation, workspace import, CLI adapter, report, agent-builder, tool-builder, provider, or Ollama surfaces.
how_to_read: Read product_boundary to decide whether a capability belongs in the desktop tracker or the separate agent/tool platform.
Read workspace_model before adding project import, clone, Git, or multi-repository behavior.
Read ui_policy before adding first-screen cards or navigation sections.
Read separated_platforms before exposing agent factory, tool studio, provider task execution, Ollama, or AWS AgentCore-style lifecycle functions.
Treat platform-desktop-app and agent-tool-desktop-app as peer installable desktop products; treat agent-platform as the shared engine and contract layer.
update_triggers: The desktop app first screen changes.
A feature creates or manages agents, tools, models, providers, Ollama, or cloud agent runtime resources.
A feature imports, clones, summarizes, reports on, or launches work inside a Git workspace.
A project boundary changes between platform-desktop-app, agent-tool-desktop-app, and agent-platform.

structure_rules.rule: The workspace tracker and the agent/tool operations product shall both be modeled as installable desktop apps.
structure_rules.reason: The user clarified that both split products are desktop apps.

structure_rules.rule: The installable desktop app shall be a workspace tracker and AI-coding surface host, not a general agent factory or tool runtime platform.
structure_rules.reason: The user wants a simpler app for importing Git workspaces, using Codex/Cursor/Claude Code/Antigravity-style tools, and seeing current work, evidence, and reports.

structure_rules.rule: New durable user workspaces shall be represented as separate Git repositories or imported existing Git repositories.
structure_rules.reason: The user wants multi-project work split by Git, not hidden under one monorepo workspace.

structure_rules.rule: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, and similar tools shall be launched or documented as replaceable guest adapters over the selected Git workspace.
structure_rules.reason: The platform should help the user use many AI coding tools well instead of becoming a wrapper around one tool.

structure_rules.rule: Agent builder, tool studio, direct provider task execution, Ollama model management, AWS AgentCore-style lifecycle, and reusable capability promotion shall belong to the separate agent-tool-desktop-app product unless a user explicitly opens the advanced operator area.
structure_rules.reason: These functions make the project-management desktop app too complex and belong in a distinct desktop product for agent/tool operations.

structure_rules.rule: The first-screen default shall emphasize active work, Git workspace status, task timeline, evidence, reports, and terminal run state before customization controls.
structure_rules.reason: The user's core problem is seeing what is happening and what was planned or proven, not configuring internals.

field_guide.meaning: Which product owns the visible capability.
How Git repositories, imported workspaces, and reports are represented.
Capabilities moved out of the desktop tracker and their target product home.
First-screen and navigation policy for the simplified user app.

desktop_tracker_product.primary_claim: Import or create Git workspaces, launch the user's preferred AI coding surface, and show current work, timeline, evidence, validation, reports, and terminal state in one simple desktop app.

agent_tool_platform.primary_claim: Build, evaluate, configure, and operate reusable agents, tools, provider connectors, model runtimes, skills, workflows, and promotion pipelines as a separate desktop app.

workspace_model.root_collection_policy: A desktop collection can remember many Git repositories, but each durable project remains its own Git repository.

separated_platforms.label: Tool builder, tool registry, Python venv, and deployment workflow
Ollama model lifecycle and local model catalog management
Direct OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or cloud-provider agent execution
AWS AgentCore/Bedrock-style agent runtime, memory, gateway, identity, observability, and evaluation lifecycle

ui_policy.home_copy_rule: Home copy shall talk about Git workspaces, current work, task reports, evidence, terminal runs, and AI coding tools as guest surfaces.
ui_policy.configuration_rule: Customization, provider credentials, direct model execution, Ollama, agent factory, and tool builder controls shall not be the default first-screen path.
ui_policy.project_management_rule: The projects section shall behave like the desktop project management hub: import Git repositories, show portfolio health, expose milestone status, and link reports, evidence, task order, and terminal run state before advanced operator controls.
